subject.title: Dashboard: inter-widget pub/sub — a tab-scoped, parent-brokered message bus

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the bundled modular-dashboard stack and allow sandboxed widgets to exchange arbitrary same-tab payloads through the proposed `bus:pubsub` parent broker?
rationale: Current main has no dashboard substrate, VISION.md does not already prioritize this program, and accepting the PR would establish both a new bundled product surface and a security-sensitive communication contract for untrusted agent-authored widgets.

options.title: Sponsor after repairs
options.body: Assign product/security ownership, land the foundation first, and require a narrow corrected pub/sub PR with real-browser proof.

options.title: Defer the dashboard stack
options.body: Keep the work paused until the dashboard program receives explicit roadmap priority and ownership.

options.title: Decline bundled dashboards
options.body: Close the program if maintainers do not want this optional capability in the core repository.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repairs
recommendation.body: Assign product/security ownership, land the foundation first, and require a narrow corrected pub/sub PR with real-browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main adjacent owner found on the bundled plugin UI host and can route or make the sponsorship decision.
